description: This file defines the Subscription report controller for the Opencart admin panel, handling report display, filtering, and saving subscription report settings.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription reports in Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the subscription report form page with filters and settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the subscription report settings after permission check.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the subscription report with data and filters.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the subscription report data as a view.
